views.markdown: Hide the carrier name in the status bar.

views.title: rootless

views.markdown:
### Compatibility

Tested on iOS 18.4.1 (Dopamine 3, roothide). The rootless build is expected to work on iOS 18+ rootless jailbreaks. The tweak requires iOS 18.0 or later.

### What it does

- Hides the carrier name in the SpringBoard system status bar.
- Keeps signal bars, network type, Wi-Fi, battery, time, badges, and SOS indicators.
- Targets both primary and secondary cellular entries.
- Applies immediately after respring.
- No preference pane or configuration.

### How it works

iOS 18 renders the carrier name from the cellular status bar data entry. Carrier Hider hooks the `STStatusBarDataCellularEntry` string getters and returns an empty string. The status bar then hides only the carrier-name item; signal, network type, and the other indicators remain.

### Scope

Carrier Hider targets the SpringBoard system status bar: Home Screen, Lock Screen, App Switcher, and Notification Center. In-app status bars on classic devices are outside this release's scope.

### Verification

SHA-256 checksums are published in `SHA256SUMS.txt` with the GitHub release.
